component.name: Wing Commander (Experimental)
component.summary: Experimental SDL2 port of Wing Commander

description.p: Play Wing Commander using your own original game files. Supports Kilrathi Saga, DOS and FM Towns data, and Super Wing Commander for Macintosh.
This Flatpak is experimental and has not been validated on Steam Deck. Please report installation, controls, saving and suspend/resume results.
Original game archives and Sega CD voice recordings are not included.
